settings.name: THE BLOOM - Cafe & Patisserie
settings.tagline: Where good food meets beautiful moments.
settings.description: A cozy café in Jayanagar serving thoughtfully crafted food, coffee, desserts and drinks in a warm botanical setting.
settings.address: 448, 18th Main Road, 4th T Block East, Pattabhirama Nagar
settings.confirmationNotes: Tables are reserved for 90 minutes. We hold reserved tables for up to 15 minutes past the scheduled arrival time. Please call or WhatsApp us if you are delayed.

menuItems.name: Classic Venetian Tiramisu
menuItems.description: Savoiardi ladyfingers steeped in fresh espresso and Marsala, layered with whipped mascarpone cream and dusted with Dutch cocoa.

menuItems.name: Biscoff Caramel Cheesecake
menuItems.description: Slow-baked creamy Philadelphia cheesecake base layered with rich spiced Lotus Biscoff spread and biscuit crumble.

menuItems.name: Artisan Dark Fudge Brownie
menuItems.description: Warm, 70% dark Belgian chocolate fudge brownie with a crackly crust, served with vanilla bean mascarpone glaze.

menuItems.name: Signature Belgian Mocha
menuItems.description: Double ristretto espresso poured over melted Belgian couverture dark chocolate with steamed silky milk.

menuItems.name: Velvet French Hot Chocolate
menuItems.description: Thick European drinking chocolate crafted with single-origin cocoa, a hint of Madagascar vanilla, and whipped cream.

menuItems.name: Handcrafted Genovese Pesto Pasta
menuItems.description: Al dente tagliatelle tossed in fragrant fresh sweet basil, roasted pine nuts, extra virgin olive oil, and aged parmesan.

menuItems.name: Glazed Raspberry & Lychee Entremet
menuItems.description: Mirror-glazed spherical entremet with lychee mousse, raspberry coulis center, and delicate almond dacquoise base.

menuItems.name: Truffle Cream Cheese Dim Sum
menuItems.description: Translucent steamed parcels filled with herbed Philadelphia cream cheese, water chestnuts, and subtle white truffle oil.

menuItems.name: Rose Vanilla Cloud Latte
menuItems.description: Lightly floral rose essence and bourbon vanilla paired with specialty espresso and velvety milk foam, garnished with dried rose petals.

menuItems.name: Iced Spanish Cortado
menuItems.description: Concentrated espresso shaken over ice with sweetened condensed milk and fresh organic whole milk.

menuItems.name: Sparkling Peach & Rosemary Iced Tea
menuItems.description: Cold-steeped Darjeeling black tea infused with white peach puree, fresh rosemary sprigs, and sparkling mineral water.

menuItems.name: Wild Burrata & Charred Sourdough
menuItems.description: Fresh artisanal burrata cheese from local dairy, heirloom cherry tomatoes, basil reduction, and grilled country sourdough.

menuItems.name: Grilled Halloumi & Roasted Pepper Panini
menuItems.description: Crispy pressed ciabatta with grilled Cypriot halloumi, fire-roasted sweet bell peppers, balsamic glaze, and rocket leaves.

menuItems.name: Slow Roasted Herb Chicken Sourdough Sandwich
menuItems.description: Thyme-basted tender chicken breast, aged gouda, pickled shallots, and house Dijon aioli on toasted artisan sourdough.

menuItems.name: Truffle & Forest Wild Mushroom Risotto
menuItems.description: Arborio rice slowly simmered with porcini stock, sautéed shiitake, shimeji mushrooms, fresh thyme, and Grana Padano.

menuItems.name: Citrus Quinoa & Avocado Garden Bowl
menuItems.description: Organic red quinoa, creamy Hass avocado, ruby grapefruit segments, crisp baby spinach, and honey-mustard vinaigrette.

menuItems.name: Seasonal Mango & Passionfruit Tart
menuItems.description: Crisp sablé tart shell filled with Alphonso mango curd, passionfruit gel, and edible pansy blossoms.

reviews.author: Sneha Kulkarni
reviews.comment: One of Jayanagar’s most charming cafe spots. The botanical aesthetic and warm lighting make it feel like an intimate garden retreat. The Tiramisu and Rose Vanilla Latte are unforgettable!

reviews.author: Rahul Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Loved the outdoor balcony seating, such a peaceful vibe in 4th T Block. The Pesto Pasta and Biscoff Cheesecake were phenomenal. Reserving a table online made the weekend brunch completely hassle-free.

reviews.author: Meera Venkatesh
reviews.comment: The house-style atmosphere is cozy and romantic. Attentive hospitality, thoughtfully crafted coffee, and aesthetic presentation across every dish.

reviews.author: Ananya Hegde
reviews.comment: A true sanctuary in the heart of Jayanagar. The Truffle Cream Cheese Dim Sum and Velvet Hot Chocolate are to die for! Perfect for slow mornings or date evenings.
